subject: social
title: People We Remember
about: Why we have Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents' Day, Veterans Day, Memorial Day and Labor Day, and the people behind them: Dr. King's work for fairness, George Washington and Abraham Lincoln, and the workers and service members we thank. NC 1.H.1.1 (people whose achievements changed communities) and 1.B.1.1 (holidays and traditions).
tip: When a holiday closes school, ask him who or what it remembers and one thing that person did for others.

cards.q: Martin Luther King Jr. worked so that all people would be treated how?
cards.sayQ: Martin Luther King Junior worked so that all people would be treated how?
cards.note: Dr. King wanted every person treated fairly, no matter the color of their skin.

cards.q: How did Dr. King try to change unfair rules?
cards.note: He used words, not fists. Many people marched with him.

cards.q: Dr. King dreamed that children of every skin color could do what together?
cards.note: He hoped kids of all colors would be friends and go to school together.

cards.q: On Martin Luther King Jr. Day, many people help neighbors and clean up parks. It is a day of...
cards.sayQ: On Martin Luther King Junior Day, many people help neighbors and clean up parks. It is a day of...
cards.note: Service means helping others. It is a way to honor Dr. King.

cards.q: Presidents' Day comes in which month?
cards.note: Presidents' Day is the third Monday in February.

cards.q: Presidents' Day honors George Washington and which other famous president?
cards.note: Both presidents were born in February. Dr. King was not a president. He has his own day in January.

cards.q: Long before he was president, George Washington led which group?
cards.note: He led the army that helped America become its own country.

cards.q: George Washington is called the Father of our...
cards.note: People call him that because he helped start the United States.

cards.q: Whose face is on the one-dollar bill?
cards.note: Look at a one-dollar bill and you will see George Washington.

cards.q: Which coin has George Washington on it?
cards.note: A quarter is worth 25 cents. George Washington is on the front.

cards.q: Which coin has Abraham Lincoln on it?
cards.note: A penny is worth 1 cent. Abraham Lincoln is on the front.

cards.q: Abraham Lincoln always tried to tell the truth. What nickname did people give him?
Abraham Lincoln grew up in a small log cabin and loved to read. What did he grow up to be?
cards.note: He read every book he could borrow, by the light of the fire.

cards.q: Abraham Lincoln worked so that people who were enslaved could be...
cards.note: Free means you can choose where to live and where to work.

cards.q: A veteran is a person who did what?
cards.note: Veterans were soldiers, sailors, pilots or marines.

cards.q: On Veterans Day, what can you say to a veteran?
cards.note: Veterans Day is November 11. Saying thank you shows we remember their service.

cards.q: Memorial Day, at the end of May, remembers soldiers who did what for our country?
cards.note: People put out flowers and flags to remember them.

cards.q: Labor Day, in September, is a holiday that honors which people?
cards.note: Labor means work. Labor Day thanks everyone who works hard at a job.
